blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 30 Temporary Operator’s Permits (TOPs) have been issued during the first week of enforcement of the Motorist Discipline Zone along the Transcentral Highway (TCH), while two motorcycles have been impounded for excessively noisy mufflers, according to the Land Transportation Office in Central Visayas (LTO-7).
